addAmountBet: Add the amount of drinking credits you want to bet
noPoints: This game will not result in any points! Only drinking!
betCredits: Bet drinking credits on number and/or color
ifWin: If you win, the winning amount will be added in the standings table
ifLose: If you lose, the betting amount will be subtracted in the standings table
correctNumber: Correct number: Win = 36 x bet amount
positiveScore: Postive score = give out drinking credits
negativeScore: Negative score - your glass will be filled
